translation: Noon. By the pen, and by what they inscribe
By the grace of your Lord, you are not insane
In fact, you will have a reward that will never end
And you are of a great moral character
You will see, and they will see
Which of you is the afflicted

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
translation: Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best the well-guided
So do not obey the deniers
They would like you to compromise, so they would compromise
And do not obey any vile swearer
Backbiter, spreader of slander
Preventer of good, transgressor, sinner
Rude and fake besides
Just because he has money and children

arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: When Our Verses are recited to him, he says, “Myths of the ancients!”
We will brand him on the muzzle

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
translation: We tested them, as We tested the owners of the garden, when they vowed to harvest it in the morning
Without any reservation

arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
translation: But a calamity from your Lord went around it while they slept
And in the morning it was as if picked
In the morning, they called to one another

arabic: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
translation: “Go early to your plantation, if you are going to harvest.”
So off they went, murmuring to one another

arabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينٞ
translation: “No poor person is to enter it upon you today.”
And early they went, resolved in intent
But when they saw it, they said, “We were wrong
We are now deprived.”

arabic: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
translation: The most reasonable of them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘if only you would glorify?’”

arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
translation: They said, “Glory to our Lord—We were indeed in the wrong.”
Then they turned to one another, blaming one another
They said, “Woe to us—we were indeed domineering

arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرٗا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
translation: Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. We are turning to our Lord.”

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: Such is the punishment; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew

arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
translation: For the righteous are Gardens of Delight with their Lord
Shall We treat the Muslims like the villains
What is the matter with you? How do you judge
Or do you have a scripture in which you study
Wherein there is whatever you choose

arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
translation: Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand
Ask them, which of them will guarantee that

arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Or do they have partners? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful

arabic: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقٖ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
translation: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called to bow down, but they will be unable

arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
translation: Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. They were invited to bow down when they were sound

arabic: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: So leave Me to those who reject this discourse; We will proceed against them gradually, from where they do not know
And I will give them respite. My plan is firm

arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
translation: Or do you ask them for a fee, so they are burdened with debt
Or do they know the future, and so they write it down

arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ
translation: So wait patiently for the Decision of your Lord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair

arabic: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومٞ
translation: Were it not for his Lord’s favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised
But his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous

arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
translation: Those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message, and say, “He is crazy!”
But it is no less than a reminder to all the Worlds
